    task.spawn(function()

    local steps = 60

    for i = 1, steps do

        elseif percent < 75 then
            LoadStatus.Text = "Bypassing anti-cheat systems... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        else
            LoadStatus.Text = "Finalizing TRL Mode v5.0... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        end
        
        task.wait(sleepTime)

    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(LoadScreen, tweenInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    for _, child in ipairs(LoadScreen:GetDescendants()) do
